description:
Add a new satellite clinic location to the Oscar EMR system. 

Log in as admin (oscardoc / oscar / PIN: 1117). Navigate to the Administration panel, find the 'System Management' or 'Clinic/Facility' section, and add a new Branch/Location with the following details:

- Name/Location: West End Clinic
- Address: 880 West Drive
- City: Toronto
- Province: ON
- Phone: 416-555-9000
- Fax: 416-555-9001

Ensure the new location is saved and visible in the system.
